messages:
tara: Heads-up: prod (eu-west1) embeddings 5xx spike on large-batch path after today's deploy. I have a hotfix that re-adds a safety clamp on batch assembly and reduces max_batch_size for the slow path. Need expedited rollout: staging smoke -> staggered prod (10% -> 100%) within 20m. Requesting override of multi-canary. @li @matt please ack.
deploy-bot: Policy: service=embeds requires canary. Override allowed with 2 eng + 1 SRE approvals.
li: Whats the rollback plan if we see new 5xx?
tara: Rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/embeds redwood/embed=redwood/embed:v3.0.1` (current). No DB changes, no secrets. Hotfix image: `redwood/embed:v3.0.2-hotfix-191246`.
matt: I'll run staging smoke & targeted batch-load probe. smoke script: `bin/smoke_embeds --region eu-west1 --batch-sizes 32,64` TTL ~3m.
release-manager: Note: if this goes to prod, I need a 1-sentence release note and changelog entry before final rollout.
oncall-sre: I'll set alerting: eu-west1 5xx > 0.8% => auto-rollback. I'll also run synthetic short+long batch hits.
matt: staging smoke started.
matt: staging smoke PASS. batch edge cases exercised, kv warm, no 5xx in 4m.
li: +1 from me after staging smoke.
tara: +1 from me. Ben (SRE) please confirm? /cc @oncall-sre
oncall-sre: +1. Ill keep synthetic running and will escalate if error-rate > 0.8% for 2m.
tara: Triggering expedite. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v3.0.2-hotfix-191246 --target staging --pin --override-canary --notes "hotfix: safety clamp on batch assembly; reduces max_batch_size on slow path"```
deploy-bot: Override flag detected. Approval log: tara/li/oncall-sre. Scheduling staging deploy.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded. sha=beefcafe. healthcheck=smoke-sigs.
tara: Rolling to prod with staged roll: 10% (3m) -> 50% (5m) -> 100% (7m), monitor thresholds as set. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v3.0.2-hotfix-191246 --target prod --pin --rollout 100% --notes "expedite: batch safety clamp hotfix"```
deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Auto-rollback if eu-west1 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 2m.
oncall-sre: Synthetic at 10% ok. No regression.
matt: 50% step stable.
release-manager: Draft release note: "embeds: fix rare 5xx from large-batch assembly by reintroducing safety clamp; no schema changes." Saving draft here: https://docs.internal/releases/191246-batch-safety.
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed to 100%. No rollback triggered.
tara: Thanks all. Keeping 1h watch, will ping if any regressions. Closing thread after 60m.
release-manager: After 30m I'll publish the release note and update changelog.
oncall-sre: Watch continues; alerts muted for now but will escalate on signal.
